title: Claude's web sign-in draws Claude's own callback address (localhost:53692/callback) and says how to copy it from a window with no address bar
steps: S1: run the tracy-model-plan accounts-pane tests (node:test, jsdom page, fake /api/seat-plan doors): pick Claude, press Connect now with an authorizeUrl whose redirect_uri is http://localhost:53692/callback, read the panel.
expect: ol[data-steps='browser-callback'] still holds exactly three li: open, refused, copy.
Step 2 holds small[data-hint='popup'] reading 'Opened in a small window with no address bar? Use its menu (⋮) and choose Open in Chrome, then copy the address.'
The address-bar drawing under step 3 reads 'localhost:53692/callback?code=…' and the panel never mentions 1455.
The drawn address is the host and path of the attempt's redirect_uri plus '?code=…'; with no readable redirect_uri it falls back to 'localhost:1455/auth/callback?code=…'.

tests: the address to copy is drawn from the attempt: the redirect the vendor sends the browser back to
Claude's sign-in draws Claude's callback address and says what to do with an address-less window
a browser sign-in says what happens before the page opens: three steps in order, the refused page announced, then the paste box

fence: the address the person is told to copy is read from the attempt's own redirect_uri, never a constant of another vendor
